snippet.title: Orbit Dash 2.0 — 10 Ball Trails | Rhythm Tap Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Orbit Dash 2.0 is here: a clean neon look on every screen and 10 ball trails to collect. Buy four with gems, earn five by clearing music levels, and wear your trail in Endless and in every level.

Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lewydo.orbitdash&referrer=utm_source%3Dyoutube%26utm_medium%3Dtrailer%26utm_campaign%3Dupdate_2_0

In this video:
• HELIX and EMBERS in Endless mode
• Picking a trail in the Shop
• STARBORN with NOVA, NEON DRIFT with DRIFT, HYPERLANE with ZAP
• Clearing NEON DRIFT and earning its trail
• Revive after a late fall

Orbit Dash is a one-tap rhythm game: tap to the beat and jump between two orbits. 5 handcrafted music levels on original tracks, an endless mode with boosters and combos up to ×5, and a golden crown for perfect runs. All music is original, made by Lewydo for the game.

Lewydo is a two-person indie studio from Ukraine. Love What You Do.
https://roshevasternin.github.io/

#OrbitDash #RhythmGame #IndieGame
